question: Does a front-of-pack named fungal or plant ingredient (có nấm hương; có đạm nấm) in an industrial xúc xích change purchase intent, compared with no front claim and with 'thịt heo 55%, thay 20% bằng đạm thực vật' (20% replaced by plant protein)?
why_it_matters: Decides whether TPP-03 should name the plant part as an ingredient or declare meat replaced, and whether R3 can grow beyond undeclared binder use
cheapest_way_to_close: Randomised label test at equal price, about 300 shoppers in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi, with a blind tasting arm
owner_org_to_ask: HUST food sensory group; GFI APAC; a processor (Vissan or Masan MEATLife)

question: What did the laboratory find in the chả đòn chay seized in An Giang (Phu Tan) on 22 April 2021 on suspicion of meat and fish?
why_it_matters: The only official meat-in-chay case; a positive result would show that fake chay exists in industrial chay rolls
cheapest_way_to_close: Written request to the An Giang Department of Agriculture and Environment and provincial environmental police

question: Have QUATEST 3, NIFC or provincial labs run animal-DNA screens on market chay since 2020, and with what positive rate?
why_it_matters: Sets DMV-07's priority for meat DNA and whether 'verified meat-free' is worth paying for on TPP-02
cheapest_way_to_close: Records request or a short call to QUATEST 3 (service launched February 2025) and NIFC
owner_org_to_ask: QUATEST 3; National Institute for Food Control; VFA

question: How do Vietnamese shoppers read 'đạm đậu nành' on a sausage label: as nutrition, as neutral or as filler?
why_it_matters: Tells processors whether soy on the label is a liability and whether a non-soy (đạm nấm) label has value, as W8-L6 asked
cheapest_way_to_close: Two items added to any planned consumer survey or choice experiment
owner_org_to_ask: Survey owner for DMV and ch23 experiments

question: Do processors receive complaints about soy or starch in their products, and have any reformulated or relabelled because of them?
why_it_matters: Direct evidence of a trust penalty on declared extenders in branded lines
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask in the processor interviews already proposed (AIB-L05, W8-L6 candidate 1)

question: How large are online complaints about độn in giò, chả and xúc xích at pork price peaks (2019 to 2020, 2026)?
why_it_matters: Sizes the trust penalty a price-driven extender would face
